a.lede: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.
a.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes

b.lede: Anthropic is launching some new Claude AI features to help software engineers ship code. As part of a new Claude Ship product being announced today, Claude now can review, fix, and approve pull requests.
